1.

Soon the morning star shall rise, Then all our hope shall be fulfilled At the Lord’s sweet meeting; When the bride, raised above the earth, Shall be brought in holy joy Up into her Bridegroom’s bosom. The time, the conflict soon shall end, Peace be enjoyed, The crown be won, The goal of bliss be attained.

2.

No more with dim and feeble gaze Shall we behold the features of God’s countenance In the mirror of the word portrayed; But the Lord’s unclouded glory see, See Jesus’ sweet face With glory radiant, Blessedly, blessedly shall we experience All the fair, True, exalted, That here was glimpsed by our eye.

3.

O blissful day, Thee we await; We stand ready, already clothed in The white festival garment. Come, Jesus! “Yea, I come quickly,” Thou dost answer us; we hear clearly Thy voice in the morning watch. Amen! Amen! Thou shalt come; Thy godly ones Shall greatly rejoice And with thanksgiving and praise come forth.
